q01-choose.observed_description: Seen from above on a light-gray table: one yellow pencil with a pink eraser on the left, one closed blue spiral notebook on the right, and between them an adult hand reaching in from the bottom with the palm up and five fingers spread, touching neither. Nothing else on the table; no writing.
q01-choose.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The open hand between the two things reads as a choice, which is what the word or needs.
